name: memseek-memory
description: Durable, provenance-aware project memory for Claude Code.

MEMSEEK_URL.title: Memseek service URL
MEMSEEK_URL.description: Base URL supplied by your Memseek administrator, without a trailing slash (for example, https://memory.example.com).

MEMSEEK_API_KEY.title: Memseek workspace key
MEMSEEK_API_KEY.description: Workspace key supplied by your Memseek administrator. Claude Code stores this as a sensitive value.

MEMSEEK_CAPTURE_MODE.title: Conversation capture
MEMSEEK_CAPTURE_MODE.description: Controls new writes, not recall. conversation saves exact user and assistant chat messages automatically; explicit saves only when you ask Claude to remember; off tells Claude to make no new writes. Existing memory remains readable in every mode.
